# baffinbay_ip_list (Resource)

Manages a Baffin Bay IP List.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "baffinbay_ip_list" "office_networks" {
  name = "office-networks"

  entries = [
    {
      value = "198.51.100.0/24"
      note  = "Stockholm office"
    },
    {
      value = "2001:db8:100::/48"
      note  = "Office IPv6"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `entries` (Attributes List) The IP or network prefixes in the list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `name` (String) The name of the IP list.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the IP list.

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Required:

- `value` (String) A canonical IPv4 or IPv6 prefix in CIDR notation.

Optional:

- `note` (String) An optional note describing the entry.

## Import

Import an IP list by UUID:

```shell
terraform import baffinbay_ip_list.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
